name: Eastern Catholic churches

facts.value: Christians of Eastern rites in communion with the pope, each generally corresponding to a separated Eastern church.

citations.excerpt: The definition of an Eastern-Rite Catholic is: A Christian of any Eastern rite in union with the pope : i.e. a Catholic who belongs not to the Roman, but to an Eastern rite. They differ from other Eastern Christians in that they are in communion with Rome , and from Latins in that they have other rites.
and lastly the Catholic Eastern Rites corresponding in each case to a schismatical body.

research_notes: Family of churches with different dates; dates are on member entries. No single start date. Relationship (communion with Rome) is sourced.
